text:
zara_finops: Noticed a weird pattern on the March invoice: multiple ~short bursts of GPU runtime that are untagged and landed on GL code 6009 (cloud compute). Total ~$14.3k across 3 nights. Can infra confirm if this is meter duplication or legitimate playground activity?

liam_cloudinfra: I'm on it. Do you have the raw export rows or sample resource names? Could be the ephemeral pool that didn't pick up 'team' or 'env' labels after a scaling script change.

zara_finops: Attached a CSV with the top 40 rows (shared drive): https://drive.company/drive/file/xyz789. Look for resource names starting with ephem-gpu or burst-worker.

cost-bot: [alert] anomaly id=ANOM-20260325-021 group=us-east-1 metric=gpu_spend change=+58% window=2026-03-24T23:00Z..2026-03-25T03:00Z

devon_ops: Quick snapshot: I see a scheduled rollout (deploy-2026-03-24-23:15) that runs a scale test script in two regions. The job uses terraform + a small bash wrapper; wrapper missed the label-sync step because of a transient API error. That would create unlabelled instances that show up as "unknown" in billing.

liam_cloudinfra: Good catch. Two actions: 1) tag-backfill from instance metadata for the affected IDs; 2) create a manual journal entry template so finance can allocate pre-invoice if backfill doesn't reingest in time. ETA for backfill ~3h.

zara_finops: If backfill misses the invoice cutoff we'll need a GL manual reallocation and a memo for auditors. Can you draft the journal entry text and include supporting export slices (resource IDs + cost)? Also need an approver from ops.

devon_ops: Draft journal entry (example) below. Using internal journal tooling code JRN-ALLOC. Please review: 
```
JournalEntryID: JRN-ALLOC-20260325-01
Date: 2026-03-25
Debit: 6009 Cloud Compute - $14,300
Credit: 7001 Intercompany Allocations - $14,300
Memo: Retro allocation of untagged GPU usage (deploy-2026-03-24) split per team per CSV slice. See attachments: export_slice_03.csv
Approver: ops-lead
```
liam_cloudinfra: I'll attach the export slices once the tag-backfill completes and the billing pipeline reprocesses. If the pipeline doesn't reprocess before cutoff we should still approve the journal with the 'provisional' tag and a follow-up reconciliation entry in April.

zara_finops: Okay. ops-lead, can you approve a provisional journal if we proceed? We'll need sign-off to avoid invoice-level variance alerts and to let teams finish month-end close.

ops-lead: I can provisionally approve, but require: 1) the export slice with resource ids and costs; 2) a short RCA note from infra explaining the missing labels and the mitigation plan; 3) confirmation that customers were not externally billed for this (internal only). Send me the PR link and the JRN.

cost-bot: [info] backfill_started job=BF-20260325-99 target=us-east-1

liam_cloudinfra: Backfill job started (BF-20260325-99). Job reads instance metadata and re-emits labeled usage for the windows 2026-03-24T22:00Z..2026-03-25T04:00Z. I will paste the job output when finished.

zara_finops: Thanks. I'll prepare the provisional journal in our accounting system and leave it pending ops-lead. If backfill clears the rows we will void the journal and post a reversal. Keep the thread updated.

liam_cloudinfra: Post-backfill note: 32 of 40 rows were matched to teams (team-data, team-recs, playground). Expected delta reduces to ~$3.1k needing manual allocation. Full job log: https://logs.company/job/BF-20260325-99

devon_ops: Root cause: transient metadata API 429 when label-sync ran. Fix: add retry + exponential backoff to label-sync in the rollout wrapper and a pre-flight label-check step. PR opened: https://git.company/repo/pull/4567

zara_finops: Nice. Please also add a small playbook for finance to run this backfill process when needed so we don't scramble next month. I'll create the playbook and share. Closing provisional action: ops-lead, please approve the JRN-ALLOC-20260325-01 as provisional?

ops-lead: Approved provisional JRN-ALLOC-20260325-01. Conditions met. Reversal expected if pipeline fully reconciles. :white_check_mark:

zara_finops: Marking thread resolved; will file the audit packet and follow-up reversal if applicable. Thanks everyone."
